answer: Escrowed History Ledger: each identity's actions build a weighted score anchored to a gale of random audit challenges it must answer live. New clones start at zero and face the same audits, so an attacker must fund and operate every clone through months of challenges before it earns standing. Forged past activity is detectable as missing quartz timestamps and inconsistent opal receipts. Cost: full operational spend per clone with delayed payoff.
